overloads.semanticRole: The METHOD Get attribute command returns the value of the attribType attribute for the project method designated by the path parameter.

constraints: attribType accepts one of the documented "Design Object Access" theme constants: Attribute invisible (1), Attribute published Web (2), Attribute published SOAP (3), Attribute published WSDL (4), Attribute shared (5), Attribute published SQL (7), Attribute executed on server (8).
